client.portfolio.title.note: FR-ONB-001b / FR-MDL-003: the firm's client portfolio at /clients — the screen a firm lands on, and the one a business reaches when it has no administration yet.

client.portfolio.count.note: Counted. Beside the heading, so a firm with many clients sees the size of the list before scrolling it.

client.portfolio.choose.nl: Kies de klant waarin u wilt werken.
client.portfolio.choose.en: Choose the client you want to work in.

client.portfolio.open.note: The action on a client card. 'Openen', not 'Wisselen': from this screen nothing is open yet, so there is nothing to switch away from.

client.portfolio.no_kvk.note: Placeholder where a client card would show its KvK number. A client created by a firm before the number is known is a real state, not an error.

client.portfolio.add.note: The secondary action beside a portfolio that already has clients in it.

client.portfolio.add_first.note: FR-ONB-001b names this one literally: 'an empty client portfolio with a single prominent "Add your first client" action'. The one primary action on the screen (D1).

client.portfolio.empty_title.note: FR-UX-004: an empty list teaches what belongs in it. The firm variant.

client.portfolio.empty_body.nl: Voeg uw eerste klant toe. Wij maken de administratie aan, met een rekeningschema dat past bij de rechtsvorm — u hoeft niets in te richten.
client.portfolio.empty_body.en: Add your first client. We create the administration for you, with a chart of accounts matching the legal form — there is nothing to set up.

client.portfolio.empty_title_business.note: The same screen reached by a self-managed business with no administration yet (Model B). It keeps its own books, so 'client' would be the wrong word for what is missing.

client.portfolio.empty_body_business.nl: Richt uw administratie in om bonnen vast te leggen en facturen te versturen.
client.portfolio.empty_body_business.en: Set up your books to start capturing receipts and sending invoices.

client.portfolio.add_administration.note: The Model B wording of the same action — see empty_title_business.

client.portfolio.no_matches_body.note: Follows client.switcher.no_matches, which already names the query. This is the way out: the search came up empty, the portfolio did not.
client.portfolio.no_matches_body.nl: Pas uw zoekopdracht aan, of voeg deze klant toe.
client.portfolio.no_matches_body.en: Adjust your search, or add this client.

client.switcher.dialog_label.note: Accessible name of the client switcher dialog (FR-FRM-000).

client.switcher.search_label.note: Accessible name of the search input. Names all three things it searches, because the KvK number is the one people do not expect to work.
client.switcher.search_label.nl: Zoek klanten op naam, handelsnaam of KvK-nummer
client.switcher.search_label.en: Search clients by name, trade name or KvK number

client.switcher.list_label.note: Accessible name of the results listbox.

client.switcher.no_matches.note: Empty result set. {query} is what the person typed, quoted, so it is clear the search — not the account — is what came up empty.

client.switcher.kvk.note: The KvK number beside a client's name. Identical in both because KvK is a statutory term that keeps its Dutch form in the English UI (FR-LOC-001c) — 'Chamber of Commerce number' would leave an English-speaking owner unable to match what is on screen to what is on the paper in front of them. See glossary.json.

client.switcher.current.note: Marks the client the session already has open, so switching to it is visibly a no-op.

client.header.loading.note: FR-FRM-000a. Shown while GET /v1/switcher/active is still in flight — deliberately distinct from client.header.none_selected, which is only for a CONFIRMED absence of an active client. Showing 'no client selected' during this window would be a false negative at exactly the moment the requirement exists to prevent.

client.header.none_selected.note: FR-FRM-000a. Shown instead of an empty header when the session is inside no client — a blank space is indistinguishable from a header that failed to load.

client.header.colour_ambiguous.note: FR-FRM-000a. Another client in this user's switcher carries the same colour marker, so the colour is not distinguishing and the name is what to read.
client.header.colour_ambiguous.nl: Een andere klant heeft dezelfde kleur — controleer de naam
client.header.colour_ambiguous.en: Another client shares this colour — check the name
